data.heading: Conservation
data.rubric: Click on the image to find out.
data.text: Protecting and managing the Earth's natural resources and environment so that they are still here for future generations is called conservation.
What would have happened to our rivers and streams if people who lived before us hadn't taken care of them?
We would not have fresh drinking water.
There would be no fish in our rivers.
What would have happened if people who lived before us had chopped down the trees?
We wouldn't have wood for building houses and furniture.
There wouldn't be a place for animals to live.
We would have less fresh air to breathe.
